title: Colorway
content: ### **List of Contents** **Open and Update** **Add** **Edit** **Set Option** **View Mode** **Snapshot** **Switch Colorway** #### **A garment file can be applied in various colors.** **** #### #### **Open and Update** 1. Click the Main Menu » Production » **Colorway (O).** 2. After editing and adjusting the 3D view, click the **Update** button at the top left of the Colorway Editor. #### #### **Add** **Add (Default)** 1. Click the ![Icon Button1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33016678706073) 'Add' button at the top-right corner in Colorway Editor. → By default, a colorway is added based on the selected colorway, allowing only the material properties such as color and texture to be changed. Therefore, a single item (fabric, graphic, trims, etc.) will have different materials for each colorway, and this can be confirmed in the object browser. **![Materials.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33900058646681)** **📝Note:** Even if the Colorway Editor window is closed, you can check the variations for each colorway in the object browser, and you can show or hide them with ![Button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33016752132377) **Show All Colorways** option in the top left corner. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38137431723417) **Add as Custom Settings** For various colorways, you can directly set the variation application range for each item. Refer to the example below and set it at once in the colorway addition step, and easily edit and manage it. 1. Click the ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33900118520729) 'Add as Custom Settings' button at the top-right corner in Colorway Editor. → A list of items for the selected colorway appears in the Add Colorway window. ![Add Colorway.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/32988767931801) 2. Directly set the variation application range for each item of the colorway to be added. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Materials** | Based on the item of the selected colorway, only [material properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials) such as color and texture can be changed. The same applies as for additional (default) results. _Example) If the physical properties of the fabric and the shape of the button are the same but only the color is different_ ![Materials.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33900058646681) **All Properties** | Items in the selected colorway are automatically copied and applied as new items, allowing all properties to be changed differently. _Example) If it is a completely different fabric or the shape of the button is different._ ![All Properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33900118551833) **Link** | It can be used as the same item as the selected colorway without changing its properties. This option is applied simultaneously when two items are linked to each other and their properties are changed. _Example) When the same fabric and graphics (logo) are used in all colorways_ ![Link.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33900118572697) #### #### **Edit** **Change Properties** 1. Select the thumbnail of the item you want to change in the Colorway Editor window, or select the item in the object browser. → The properties of the item appear in the property editor. 2. Change [material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures) properties. 3. Properties other than material can be changed by directly selecting the corresponding item in the object browser. **📝****Note:** After selecting a graphic with Transform Graphic tool, uncheck the '**Property Editor > Link All Colorways > Angle or Position'** option to rotate or position the graphic differently for each colorway. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38137431723417) ## ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45591047474713) ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45590542185369) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/SdzGQ4nxT2o?feature=shared&t=15) Edit the fabric's side and back, along with trims, directly in the Colorway Editor. ![colorway1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45592187269273) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38137431723417) #### **Assign Items** You can easily and quickly choose whether to apply it to the current colorway only or to all colorways when assigning an item from the Object Browser. 1. Drag and drop an item (fabric, graphics, subsidiary materials, etc.) from Object Browser to the 3D garment. 2. In Assign to Colorway window, specify how an item will be assigned to the colorway by default. _*__This window will appear only the first time. The default setting can be changed in**User Settings » Other » Colorway** option. _ 3. Even with a default setting, the option can still be changed by pressing the **Ctrl** key while dragging and dropping afterward. _**✨Tip:**_ Drag and drop the items from Object Browser, Library or your computer onto the thumbnail in Colorway Editor. It can be applied to the item of that colorway, not all colorways. #### #### **Set Option** 1. Right-click on each colorway or each item's thumbnail in a colorway to set the desired options. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Colorway** | **Delete** | Delete the colorway. **Rename** | Change the name of the colorway. **Item** | **Unlink All Colorways** | Unlink the linked item so that it can have different materials applied to each colorway or apply different properties altogether. **Select All with Same Color** | The same color within the colorway is automatically selected. **Hide Other Graphics** | You can quickly hide multiple graphics at once. Hide all other graphics that use the same item as the selected graphic. ![Colorway_hide graphics.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38214025050777) #### #### **View Mode** 1. Click the **Show Details** button at the bottom-right corner. → Colorway window switches to "Viewer Mode" where you can see the colorway thumbnails only. 2. Size thumbnails by controlling the scroll bar at the bottom-left corner, or arrange the thumbnails in single or multiple lines by clicking the arrangement button. #### #### **Snapshot** 1. Click on the **Save Image** button at the left-top corner. 2. Select either a snapshot of the 3D garments for all colorways, or the Colorway Editor showing all items used per colorway. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48746065495449) When saving a snapshot of the Colorway Editor, you can select the image scale (1x, 2x, 3x, 4x) to define the resolution of the saved file. Higher values produce larger and sharper images. #### #### **Switch Colorway** Quickly switch the current colorway by clicking color chips in the Object Browser. ![Colorway.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45591047477273) **📝Note:** If you save the garment with colorway as a project file in version 2024.1, it may not be compatible properly with lower versions (2024.0, 7.3). Therefore, if necessary, it is recommended to separately save the project file for colorway compatibility through the '**Main Menu > File > Save As > Project (with Other Files) menu**' option. #### **Go back to the List of Contents**
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for using the Colorway Editor, detailing how to open, add, edit, and manage garment color variations efficiently.

title: Schematic Render
content:
**** Render 3D Garments into technical drawings for tech packs. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48712050581273) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/L0JaKhZleyI) **** 1. Activate ![Render Schematic On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48712072683289) **Schematic Render** within the 3D window. 2. Set the following options as needed. **Main Menu** | **Description** ---|--- **Line Thickness** | Show or hide the silhouette line (the outline of the area where the garment and the background meet and the line of the wrinkled area inside the garment), seam line, internal line and topstitch line and adjust the line thickness. **Topstitch** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48712072690841) Set specifications of Topstitches to achieve a certain visual appearance in the Schematic Render. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48712050581273)](https://youtu.be/Gv2Byz5WTFI?si=RIVTNhd20zmdARTu) 1. Click the topstitch in topstitch tab of the Object Browser. 2. In the Property Editor, activate the **Local Schematic Scale** option by clicking the checkbox. 3. Set the topstitch parameters that appear below.
**Length** : Adjusts the length of each thread. **Spacing** : Defines the spacing between each thread. **Offset** : Adjusts the distance of the stitch from the edge of the applied line. **Thickness** : Controls the visual thickness of the stitch thread. **Width** : Sets the width of the stitch (especially class 500 & 600 stitches). **Distance** : Defines the distance between each stitch line. **Line Color** | Adjust the color of the line. **Garment Color** | Adjust the color of the garment. **Brightness** | Adjust the brightness of the garment.
content_description: Create precise technical drawings for tech packs by rendering 3D garments into detailed schematics with customizable options for line thickness, topstitch specifications, and garment colors.

title: Group Internal Lines and Shapes
content: ## **New in CLO 2025.0** Group with Transform Pattern Group with Edit Pattern Select or Edit Grouped Items with Transform Pattern Ungroup with Transform Pattern #### Group the selected internal lines and shapes. Group baselines and shapes is also suitable. #### #### **Group with Transform Pattern** 1. Select 2 or more internal lines or shapes. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Group** to group the selected items. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48694578661401)** ## ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48694628210329) [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50833136272281)](https://youtu.be/dF0OgRxNnwg?si=aU-ZM7oCvjLxNXWg) • A shortcut key for grouping is available. **Function** | **Shortcut** ---|--- **Group** | Windows: Ctrl + G / Mac: Command + G **Ungroup** | Windows: Ctrl + Delete / Mac: Command + Delete; or Command + Fn + Backspace • When grouping or ungrouping internal lines or shapes on one side of a symmetric or half-symmetric pattern, both sides are impacted. • Group relationship is maintained for pattern copy & paste, symmetrical copy, cutting, and merging cases. #### #### **Group with Edit Pattern** 1. Select the whole group of internal lines and segment points. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Group** to group the selected items. **📝****Note:** When selecting an incompleted line or point of Internal Line or Shape, the Group menu will not show. #### #### **Select or Edit Grouped Items** **with Transform Pattern** 1. Click on the grouped internal lines or shapes to select the whole group. 2. Click again on the individual internal lines or shapes to select individual lines or shapes. #### #### **Ungroup with Transform Pattern** 1. Select the grouped internal lines or shapes. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Ungroup** to remove the group relationship of the selected items.
content_description: Discover the new grouping and ungrouping features in CLO 2025.0, designed to enhance your workflow by allowing you to easily manage internal lines and shapes within your patterns.

title: CLO to Twinmotion: FBX Workflow
content: ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/52177334258201) ## ## **Objective** This guide explains how to prepare avatars and garments in your CLO project for a seamless import into Twinmotion using the correct FBX export settings. ## **Operation** There are two primary methods for importing CLO avatars and garments into Twinmotion. For either method, you can use CLO's [**Import/Export Option Preset feature**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/48665693640985-Import-Export-Option-Preset#h_01JZS3ZC16E38XAFDDSED8CDDA)**** to save your export settings, which will help streamline the export process. ### **Preserving CLO Fabric Materials in Twinmotion** This process ensures that fabric textures and details created in CLO are accurately transferred to Twinmotion. Upon import, each fabric from your CLO project will become a separate material in Twinmotion, which will require texture relinking. #### **Step 1: Bake and Export UV Maps from CLO** In CLO's UV Editor, bake and export all necessary texture maps for your garments (e.g., Diffuse, Normal, Roughness). #### **Step 2: Configure FBX Export Settings** Export the project as an FBX file using the following specific settings: * Unified UV Coordinates * Single Object * Thick (for geometry) * Scale: cm * Embed Media #### **Step 3: Relink Texture Maps in Twinmotion** After importing the FBX into Twinmotion, select one of the new materials derived from a CLO fabric. Manually relink the exported texture maps (from Step 1) to their corresponding channels in the Twinmotion material editor. #### **Step 4: Apply the Corrected Material** Once one material is correctly configured, use the material picker tool to apply this corrected material to all other surfaces that share the same fabric. **Note** : For higher fidelity, ensure that details like seamlines and puckering are included in the normal map you bake from CLO. This helps create a final render in Twinmotion that is more consistent with the original CLO design. ### **Applying New Materials in Twinmotion** This workflow is optimized for situations where you plan to replace the original CLO fabrics with new materials from the Twinmotion library. By exporting without unified UVs, you ensure that textures map cleanly across individual pattern pieces, which is ideal for applying tiling materials. #### **Step 1: Configure FBX Export Settings** Export the project as an FBX file from CLO with the following specific settings: * Unified UV Coordinates: Unchecked * Single Object * Thick (for geometry) * Scale: cm * Embed Media * Diffuse Color Combined on Texture #### **Step 2: Apply Materials in Twinmotion** Upon importing the FBX, Twinmotion will automatically group the geometry based on the materials assigned in CLO. * Behavior: All pattern pieces that shared the same fabric in CLO (e.g., "Cotton Twill") will now be treated as a single material surface in Twinmotion. * Action: Simply drag and drop a new Twinmotion material onto any part of that surface. It will instantly update all associated pattern pieces at once. **Note** : This method will not preserve Normal Maps for fine details like seamlines or puckering. However, the trade-off is superior texture mapping at the seams and edges of each pattern piece, preventing texture distortion when applying new materials in Twinmotion.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for preparing CLO avatars and garments for seamless import into Twinmotion, detailing essential FBX export settings and material management techniques.

title: Remove Device from CLO website
content: Applicable for: **7.2 and later** CLO product type: **StandAlone Onlineauth only** This forcibly ends the CLO license session on a previous device after a crash or unexpected shutdown. This allows you to activate and use the license on your current device. It's a recovery tool, not a remote logout. It only works when CLO has closed unexpectedly on the other device (e.g., termination due to software crash, sudden power off, etc.). It will not work if CLO is still running on the other device. It may take up to 15 minutes to remove the device. If you still can't login to CLO after this time, please contact support. Also Remove Device does not cancel your trial license and paid subscription. How to Remove Device 1) Log in to the CLO website. <https://www.clo3d.com/> 2) Select the profile icon at the top right and then select "[Subscription](https://www.clo3d.com/en/accounts/subscription)". 3) Click the "Remove Device" button. 4) Try logging into CLO software on a new device.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for using the "Remove Device" feature in CLO to recover your license after an unexpected shutdown, enabling you to activate it on a new device.

title: Scene and Render Properties File (ZSE)
content: ### **List of Contents** ### **Save** **Open** **Properties** **Show/Hide** 3D files imported as scene and props can be saved as a single file with render properties to be used for various garments. #### **Save as** 1. Import [OBJ files](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107-3D-File-OBJ-Import-Export) as scene and props. 2. Set the [render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-Render) properties. 3. Click the Main Menu ▶ Save as ▶ **Scene and Props** menu. 4. Click the **OK** button after setting the thumbnail option. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Auto** | The front view is applied as the thumbnail and preview image. **Custom** | Apply desired images as the thumbnail and preview image. 5. Click the **Save** button after setting the file namd and path. → The OBJ file imported as scene and props along with the render properties are saved as a ZSE file #### **Open** 1. Select the Main Menu » File » **Scene and Props** 2. Select the ZSE file to import and click the **Open** button. 3. After setting the options, Click the **OK** button. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Load Type** | Open or add the ZSE file. **Object** | Select and import only among the scene and props and render properties saved in the ZSE file. → The ZSE file is imported based on the setting. #### **Properties** 1. Click the imported Scene OBJ. 2. Set properties in Property Edior. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Specification** | **Collision** | Simulate the Scene OBJ with the garment. [**Material Type**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115015998728-%EC%9E%AC%EC%A7%88-%EC%9C%A0%ED%98%95)**,** [**Material**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/360047317454-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%EC%9E%AC%EC%A7%88-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95) | Materials can be changed to each selected component, allowing for more diverse appearances. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48958134550553) #### **Show/Hide** This allows you to show or hide Scene OBJ. 1. Hover over ![Avatar Main Hover.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48958728705177) Avatar Display and select ![Avatar Sub Scene and Props Hover.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48958735231001) **Show Scene and Props**.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for importing, saving, and managing 3D scene and prop files, including options for customizing render properties and managing visibility.

title: AI Graphic Generator
content: **List of Contents** **Open** **Generate** **Apply** #### **** Easily type in keywords to generate different graphic images to choose from to create new graphics. _* AI Graphic Generator is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service._ ### #### **Open** 1. Click ![AI Studio.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49960260626713) **AI Graphic Generator** button at the top of the Graphic tab. or Graphic Properties ▶ Materials ▶ on the right side of Basic Parameters → AI Graphic Generator window appears #### **Generate** 1. Set options, enter prompts, and click the Generate button. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49960237570841) Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image. This option is not available for the Pop Art type. **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26624585871001)** ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26546607504409)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26546607511193) **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. **History** | Previously generated images with prompts are recorded as history. History will remain until CLO software is closed. **📝****Note:****** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. **** #### **Apply** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → The result is applied to the 3D garment, and can be checked in advance. BUT, the graphic must be applied to it.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly generate and apply unique graphic images for your projects using our AI Graphic Generator, currently in beta testing.

title: AI Texture Generator
content: **List of Contents** **Open** **Generate** **Apply** Easily type in keywords to generate different texture images to choose from to create new textures. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49992226377241) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0) **Open** 1. Click the Fabric tab in the Object Browser. 2. Fabric Property ▶ Materials ▶ Click ![AI Studio.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49992226380057)**AI Texture Generator button** on the right side of the Basic Parameters. → AI Texture Generator window appears. **Generate** 1. Set options, enter prompts, and click the Generate button. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Fabric Type** | Select the fabric type. The pattern is generated on the texture of the selected fabric. **Content Type** | Select contents type. **Style** | Select the style of the texture image. **Pattern** | Select the repeated-pattern type. **Pattern Size** | Only adjusts the size of the pattern while maintaining the size of the texture. **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. Currently, prompts can only be entered in English. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![ai1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24221515189913) * **Emphasize certain words.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight. Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate:(word) 1.1times, ((word)) 1.21times. **![ai.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24220877570969)** ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24217219465625)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI texture image is generated newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Result button may update the prompts while maintaining the characteristics of the previously generated result as much as possible. **※ Note:** It may differ from the existing result depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24217219468057) **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. **History** | Previously generated images with prompts are recorded as histories. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → The result is applied to the 3D garment, and can be checked in advance. BUT, the fabric must be applied to it.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly generate and apply unique texture images using keywords in our AI Texture Generator tool for your 3D designs.

title: AI Studio
content: **New in 2025.1** **** Experience enhanced services in the integrated AI Studio, where you can quickly access a wider variety of AI features. **📝Note:** With the integration into AI Studio, please note that all AI features in CLO 2025.0 and older versions will be discontinued from early September 2025. We ask for your understanding. If you wish to continue using these features, we recommend updating to the latest version. **** 1. Click the ![AI Studio BTN.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49988596018841) **AI Studio** button in the top right corner of CLO. 2. You can select the desired feature within AI Studio to begin. * [AI Texture Generator](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/24181031004313-AI-Texture-Generator-ver-7-3) * [AI Graphic Generator](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/26546607526425-AI-Graphic-Generator) * [AI Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/33832336587545-AI-Studio-Beta) **** _**✨**_ _****_**How to Activate AI Features** Starting with CLO 2025.1, you must first complete the required verification process on the CLO Admin page to use AI features. Therefore, AI features in CLO may be deactivated until the process is complete. ![Youtube Icon \(1\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50398201183769) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=21Lt1faFg6A) 1. Sign in to the CLO web first, go to your account page. and you can find the [AI Studio Plug-in settings page](https://clo3d.com/en/accounts/ai-studio). You can also go directly to the page by clicking '**Go to CLO Admin** ' in the guide window that appears when you hover over a deactivated AI feature in CLO. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50398214731801) 2. Click the **EDIT** button to activate the desired AI features. You must agree to the AI-related terms and conditions to activate AI features using the plug-in. 3. After agreeing, click the **SAVE** button to complete the settings. 4. When you restart CLO, the AI features will be activated as set, and you can deactivate them again at any time.
content_description: Discover the enhanced AI features in CLO 2025.1 through the integrated AI Studio, and learn how to activate them for an upgraded creative experience.

title: Create 3D Pen
content: 3D Pen on Avatar 3D Pen in 3D Space Draw lines on an avatar and extract patterns. 1. Click the ![3D Pen Avatar On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948669708441) **3D Pen (Avatar)** in the 3D toolbar. → If there is a garment on the avatar, the garment appears translucent. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948841760409)** #### **on Avatar** 1. Hover over the avatar. → A black dot follows the mouse. 2. Click on the desired position on the avatar to create line or shape. → The line or shape appears on the avatar in black. 3. Click on the start point to complete drawing the line. → The lines or shapes are created on the avatar. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948841760409)** ## ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948871149593) #### **in 3D Space**[**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50831665344409)**](https://youtu.be/mSJLFcYUSTY?si=UFQVXi5agGqui_x7) Draw garment silhouettes around the avatar directly from the 3D space, and instantly convert them into 2D patterns. 1. Press **P** to switch between creating point within the 3D space. 2. Guidance points will be seen when creating point within 3D space to help understand where that point's relationship is within the X,Y & Z axis. \- Blue Circle measures along the z axis \- Red Circle measures along the X axis \- Green Circle measures along the Y axis 3. Hit the **D** key to see the distance between the point and the avatar. 4. Hit **Shift** key to lock the camera view and see an 8 directional guideline. 5. Hit **Enter** to end your line. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948841760409)** **📝****Note:****** * To create a curve point while drawing lines on the avatar, hold down the **Ctrl** (Windows) / **Cmmd** (Mac) key on the keyboard as you click. * Hit the **Delete** key on the keyboard to cancel the latest action or hit the **Esc** key or **Ctrl+Z** (Windows) / **Cmmd+Z** (Mac) to cancel all actions. * All lines and shapes drawn on the avatar are saved when you save the file in project, garment, or avatar file formats.
content_description: Discover how to creatively use the 3D Pen tool to draw directly on avatars in 3D space, allowing you to design and extract unique garment patterns effortlessly.

title: CLOFAB
content: **Open CLOFAB** **Fabric Information** **Map** **Physical Property** **Save Fabric** #### Digitize fabrics quickly and precisely with enhanced CLOFAB tools Built to integrate seamlessly with the new CLO zFab Kit, our hardware-based fabric digitization system. [ » Explore CLO zFab Kit](https://zfabkit.clo3d.com/) #### **Open CLOFAB** 1. Go to the **Fabric** tab in the Object Browser. 2. If you want to create a new fabric, click ![CLOFAB.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965148569) button in the top-right corner. 3. To edit an existing fabric, click ![More.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949364889) button next to the fabric and choose **Map** or **Property**. #### **Fabric Information** 1. At the top of **CLOFAB** , enter the fabric name, supplier, and owner. * All information is linked with the information entered in the **Property Editor.** #### **Map** Seamlessly generate maps with scanned or captured images. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Open and Crop** 1. Click the ![Open Map.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949367449) button to open your map images. **✨Tip:** If the files follow the [naming rule,](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/44150981805849-Import-All-PBR-Maps-Once#01JWB8QJXE4CZJ4ABC2CZ8RM4P) PBR maps in the same folder will be automatically opened together. 2. Crop your fabric image to remove any background before tiling. 3. Drag the corners or edges of the crop box to keep only the fabric area and remove any unnecessary background before tiling. 4. Press **Enter** or click ![View OK Hover.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965152793) button to apply and move on to tiling. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Auto Tiling** 1. Select the type of repeat pattern. **Pattern Type** | **Description** ---|--- **Plain/Irregular** | Fabrics with a single solid color of fabrics with irregularly scattered patterns.![Plain.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965155097) **📝Note:** This option analyzes the fabric using the normal map and only works when a normal map is included. **Repeat** | Fabrics with evenly repeating patterns. ![Repeat.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965155865) 2. Click and drag on cropped image to define a repeat section. **✨Tip:** Auto Tiling works best **when your selection includes about four repeats** , providing the best balance between accuracy and speed. ![Repeat12.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949372185) → The system automatically analyzes the selected area, displays the optimized repeat section as a grid, and previews the repeated result. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Manual Tiling** When you want to specify an area manually, switch to Manual Mode and adjust it directly. 1. In the Settings panel, uncheck the **Tiling** option. Or click ![BTN Texture Auto.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949374361) **Switch Mode** button at the bottom right of the selected area. 2. Click and drag to define a repeat section. You can refine it by dragging the corner or edge points to freely shape it into a polygon. 3. Click ![Toggle Check.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965160857) **Apply** button at the bottom right of the selected section. → The repeat result is previewed. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Post-processing** 1. If the tiled fabric looks uneven in brightness, adjust it with the **Equalize** option in the Adjustment panel. ![Equalize.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942965162009) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Apply** 1. When the map is ready, click the **Apply** button to apply it to the fabric properties. **✨Tip:** After applying the map, it will also appear in the physical property preview, allowing you to check both the map and the physical properties at the same time. #### **Physical Property** Simply enter your Fabric Type, Composition and Density to quickly create new accurate fabrics ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Create** 1. Click the **Physical Property** tab to switch. 2. Select a fabric type. * You can quickly find a type by typing its first letter on your keyboard in the fabric type list. 3. Select the composition and enter the value (%). ![Composition.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49945934590105) * Basic refers to the primary composition used for the selected fabric type, while Additional refers to compositions that can be combined as extras. → The fabric is draped based on the entered values and previewed. 4. You can check and adjust each physical property value directly in the **Advanced Details** at the bottom if needed. **✨Tip:** If no map is applied to the fabric, you can apply a default map provided for each fabric type by clicking it. Click again to remove it. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949365657) **Set Options** 1. Click **![Cylinder.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949377049)Model Type** button at the top left of the preview and set the preview shape to: Cylinder - Circle / Square, or Dummy - Cape. 2. Click **![Lock Camera.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49942949377817)Lock Camera** button to lock the view adjusted. #### **Save Fabric** Save the created maps and physical properties as a fabric file. 1. Click the **Save** button at the bottom left of **CLOFAB**. 2. Set the options. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preview Image** | Select the image type to preview the fabric. By default, the fabric’s map image is applied, but you can also add your own image if needed. **Save with Textures** | Save the fabric file along with the map images. For PBR maps, only the existing maps can be selected and saved. 3. Click **OK** and choose a folder to save the file.
content_description: Discover how to efficiently digitize, edit, and save fabric information with CLOFAB's integrated tools for precise fabric mapping and physical property management.

title: Zipper Style
content: **New in 2025.1**[**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50832046807577)**](https://youtu.be/7pFkMjfq-GQ?si=SPg8S0nsjo5ZaknN) Add Properties Assign Options **** Ability to easily manage and edit Zipper by style in the Object Browser. **** #### **Add** 1. Add a zipper style by clicking the Add button in the ![Zipper Tab.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48636135397913) zipper tab of the object browser, or[ create a zipper directly in the 3D window](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004529388-Create-and-Edit-Zipper). → A zipper with the default style will be added. **📝Note:** _You can copy an existing zipper style with the same settings by clicking the**Copy** button._ #### **Properties** **Style** 1. Select the added style in the Zipper tab to set its properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | Enter the zipper’s name, item No, and supplier. Each component of the zipper style, such as the chain, slider, puller, or stopper, can be named individually. **Function** | Set the zipper to be one-way or two-way. For two-way zippers, you can set the locking direction to either head-to-head or Bottom-to-Bottom. Changing the slider material will be applied identically to both sides. **Type** | Set the zipper type (Plastic, Nylon, Metal, etc.). **Specification** | Set the zipper gauge. The zipper width and the size of the slider, puller, and stopper can be adjusted individually **Save/Open** | Save or open the zipper style as a .ZPS file. → The changes will be applied to all 3D zippers using the selected style. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48639610643865)** **Each Component** Adjust chain, slider, and puller properties in more detail. 1. Click the corresponding chain, slider, puller, or stopper using the ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48637348293145) **Select/Move** tool. **• Select All** **** When you select one of the slider, puller, or stopper components, all related parts are selected at once. **• Select Component** If all components are currently selected, clicking one again will select only that component. **• Select Part of a Component** If a component consists of multiple meshes, clicking it again allows you to select a specific part. 2. Set selected component properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Chain** | **Length** | Adjust the length of the Zipper teeth. **Particle Distance** | Adjust the particle distance of the zipper tape pattern. **Fold** | Adjust the Strength and Angle of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. **Physical Property** | Adjust physical properties of zipper tape pattern. **Slider/Puller/Stopper** | **Size/Weight** | Set the size and weight of each component individually. **Fasten** | Select the zip direction, and select a side of the zipper tape where the slider will locate when the zipper is open. [**Material Type**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115015998728-%EC%9E%AC%EC%A7%88-%EC%9C%A0%ED%98%95)**,**[**Material**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/360047317454-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%EC%9E%AC%EC%A7%88-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95) | Materials can be changed to each selected component, allowing for more diverse appearances. **Save/Open** | Save or open the zipper style as a .ZPS file. **** #### **Apply** 1. Select a zipper with![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48637348293145) Select/Move tool. 2. Click ![assign text.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48639610647065) **Assgin to New Zipper** in the ![Zipper Tab.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48636135397913) zipper tab of the object browser. → The default zipper style will be added and applied simultaneously. 3. Or, click **![Assign.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51923797911449)Assign to Selected Zipper** next to another style. → The selected zipper will be changed. **** #### **Options** 1. Right-click on the ziper style in the ![Zipper Tab.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48636135397913) zipper tab of the object browser. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete** | Delete the selected zipper style, or delete all unused zipper styles at once. _**✨Tip:**_ _Zipper styles can also be deleted by clicking the Delete icon, but styles that are currently in use cannot be removed._ **Rename** | Rename the zipper style. _**✨Tip:** You can also rename a zipper style by double-clicking its name directly._ **Reset** | Reset the selected zipper to the default style.
content_description: Discover the new features in version 2025.1 that simplify zipper management and customization in the Object Browser, enhancing your design workflow.

title: Express Denim Wet Wash
content: **New in 2025.1** Apply Wet Process Presets Wash Parameters **** Express Denim wet wash effects without using external software and avoid many back-and-forth steps. #### **Apply** 1. [Change the Material Type](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015998728-Material-Type) to the**Denim.** → It is applied as unwashed by default. 2. Apply the denim texture as the [Base Color Map](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials#01J8J0B16SJ6HJCMDVGKG9XNFB). 3. Set the Denim Wet Wash type. → The wash effects are applied on the Fabric's Base Color Map. #### **Wet Process Presets** 1. **Unwashed:** The denim retains its raw, original state. It's typically stiff, dark, and may have a slightly rough texture. The color is a deep, uniform indigo with no fading or alteration. 2. **Rinse Wash:** The rinse wash gives denim a clean and slightly softened look. The fabric retains its original color, but with a more even tone and a softer feel. 3. **Enzyme Wash:** This wash results in a softer fabric and a slightly faded appearance. It provides a more broken-in feel without significant color loss. 4. **Stone Wash:** Stone washing creates a worn and faded appearance. The use of pumice stones produces a pronounced contrast between light and dark areas, giving the denim a distressed look. 5. **Acid Wash:** Acid wash creates a heavily contrasted, marbled effect. The denim has distinct light and dark splotches, resulting in a bold, aged look. 6. **Bleach Wash:** Bleach wash lightens the denim's color, ranging from subtle lightening to near-white, depending on the intensity and duration of the process. The fabric may show signs of distress and color variation. 7. **Ozone Wash:** Ozone wash fades the denim, resulting in a uniform and subtly lighter shade. This method reduces environmental impact and maintains fabric integrity. 8. **Custom Wash:** This option allows the application of custom maps, enabling the expression of unique and personalised visual effects. The appearance depends entirely on the user-defined maps & parameters, offering limitless possibilities. #### **Wash Parameters** 1. Adjust the wash parameters to express realistic wet wash effects. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Wash Map** | **Concentration/Intensity** | Set the wash effect intensity on the Base Color Map. **Transformation** | Scale, rotate or move the Wash Effect **Blend** | Plenty of Blending options are provided, which decide how the wash effect blends with the base Fabric. _* Overlay is recommended for the majority of Denim washes._ **Absorbency** | Adjust how deeply these effects need to be absorbed/spread in the Base Fabric. **Cycle Duration** | Sets the Cycle Duration/Washing Time. Longer duration removes more dye/color from the yarn (Base Color Map). **Seam Abrasion** | Enhance the Base Color Map of Puckering applied to the pattern with the respective Fabric.
content_description: Explore the new Wet Process Presets in 2025.1 to effortlessly apply realistic denim wash effects directly within the software, streamlining your design process without the need for external tools.

title: How to use Python Script in CLO?
content: **Question** How to access and use the Python Script for the Python API code on the CLO program? ** ****Location** Main Top Menu ▶ Edit ▶ **Python Script** **Operation** Follow the indicated guideline below: 1\. Open the CLO software and find the 'Edit' Button on the top menu. 2\. title: Does CLO come with default Avatars?
content: **Question** Does CLO come with default Avatars? **Answer** Yes, CLO provides three female Avatars, four male Avatars, and seven child Avatars as default. You can find the default avatars in the avatar folder of the CLO library. On the software screen, the **Library button is located at the top right in blue** , and **the shortcut key is 'Y'** on the keyboard. **Here are the steps to get the default avatars:** 1. **Identifying the 'N' Mark** * On the Library screen, the 'N' mark located at the top right corner of the avatar thumbnail indicates that a download is required. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48738868842137) 2. **Hovering Over the Avatar** * When you hover your mouse over the avatar thumbnail, a selection box appears in the top left corner of the thumbnail. 3. **Selecting the Avatar** 1. After selecting the avatar, a download link will appear on the right side of the Library popup. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48738868843673) 4. **Downloading and Using the Avatar** * Once downloaded, you can load and use the avatar as needed. Moreover, you can also find more free avatars, hair, and poses via [CONNECT ](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection)
content_description: Discover how to access and download the default avatars provided by CLO, including step-by-step instructions for easy navigation within the software.

title: How can I change my payment method?
content: **Question** How can I change the payment method? How can I remove my payment method? **Answer** To change the payment method, your subscription should be active. 1. Go to your **[Billing page](https://www.clo3d.com/en/accounts/billing)** 2. Click the "Update billing information" button and the "Update" button. 3. Change your card information and click the "Save" button. Regarding the deletion of payment information, your payment details will be automatically removed as long as your subscription is canceled. As long as your subscription is deactivated, your payment information is not stored. *The changed payment information will be reflected on your next subscription. *In case your license is not currently active, you can only update your payment method when you [purchase a new license.](https://www.clo3d.com/en/plans) *Alipay users cannot change the payment method and need to cancel and resubscribe with a new payment method. *If you have an issue regarding changing the payment method, please reach out to CLO via **[Contact Us.](https://www.clo3d.com/support/contactus)**
content_description: This page provides clear instructions on how to change or remove your payment method for your subscription.

title: I have a verification issue. What should I do?
content: **Question** I have a verification issue. What should I do? **Answer** Please use Chrome instead of other internet browsers. CLO website is optimized as Chrome. [CASE 1] If you didn't receive the verification email, please check your spam mailbox. Sometimes the verification email can be found in your spam folder, or you will need to refresh your browser. [CASE 2] If CLO web requires verification, even if you already verify it, please remove your old cookie and cache. **In Chrome** 1. On your computer, open Chrome. 2. At the top right, click More. 3. Click More tools. Clear browsing data. 4. At the top, choose a time range. To **delete** everything, select All time. 5. Next to "**Cookies** and other site data" and "**Cached** images and files," check the boxes. 6. Click Clear data. [CASE 3] Some school domains block external emails. If so, you can check your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from the domain "[clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com)". If you still have not received your verification email, please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus)[.](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus)
content_description: This page provides essential troubleshooting steps for resolving verification issues on the CLO website, emphasizing the use of Chrome and addressing common problems related to email receipt and browser settings.

title: How long does it take to create a 3D garment?
content: **Question** How long does it take to create a 3D garment? **Answer** This can range from 2 minutes for a simple t-shirt, to 2 hours for a complex jacket.

title: What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer?
content: **Question** What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer? **Answer** Although the core technology behind the solutions are the same, Marvelous Designer is primarily used in the CG, animation, and gaming industries. CLO is a more robust solution geared towards the fashion and apparel industries with functions that can be applied to various stages of the garment design development process. The primary difference between the two solutions is that the import/export of DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM files in CLO, allows for production-ready patterns to be sent to your manufacturer.
content_description: This web page aims to clarify the key differences between CLO and Marvelous Designer, highlighting their specific applications in the fashion and gaming industries.

title: I want to build an e-commerce site featuring virtual fittings. Can I use CLO?
content: **Question** I want to build an e-commerce site featuring virtual fittings. Can I use CLO? **Answer** Yes, CLO can be used to generate 3D garments in a variety of formats, and how you use that content is entirely up to you. We also offer APIs to incorporate our simulation technology for e-commerce sites via [CLO-SET Fitting service (Beta).](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#fitting-beta)
content_description: Explore how to enhance your e-commerce site with virtual fittings using CLO's 3D garment technology and APIs.

title: Can I import 3D body scan data into CLO?
content: **Question** Can I import 3D body scan data into CLO? **Answer** Yes, 3D body scans can be imported into CLO as long as they are in OBJ or FBX file format. However, the body mesh has to be "cleaned" (no holes or noises) so that garments can be fitted correctly.
content_description: Discover how to successfully import and utilize 3D body scan data in CLO for precise garment fitting.

title: I use a 2D CAD system from another software company. Can I still use CLO?
content: **Question** I use a 2D CAD system from another software company. Can I still use CLO? **Answer** Yes, as long as the 2D CAD patterns are exported in DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM format, they can be imported into CLO.
content_description: This webpage provides clarity on how to integrate 2D CAD patterns from other software into CLO by ensuring they are in the compatible DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM format.

title: Can you make patterns in CLO?
content: **Question** Can you make patterns in CLO? **Answer** Yes, we have intuitive pattern tools that can be used to generate patterns shapes from scratch.

content: **Question** Does CLO offer a version for academic institutions? **Answer** Yes, we have CLO for Academic available for academic institutions, but this plan is not open to individual students. title: Seamless Blocking
content: ## **New in 2025.1** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969578265)** #### **Create/Edit** **Set Fabric** **** The ability to section off patterns to add in different fabrics or textures without cutting the pattern.__ **** #### **Create/Edit** 1. Within the 2D toolbar under Internal polygon tool, click ![Seaming Line On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48632682493721) **Seamless Blocking** tool. 2. Single Click on a pattern outline to start the creation process of a seamless blocking line or seamless line. 3. Create or Edit the Seamless Blocking line referring to below table. **Tool** | **Action** | **Outcome** ---|---|--- ![Seaming.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969581977) **Seamless Blocking** | **Clicking once on a pattern outline** | This will start the creation process of a seamless blocking line or seamless line. You can create any type of shape with as many points as you would like, through single clicks within a pattern piece. The Symmetry rules will be followed when creating the lines. With half symmetry when creating a line that goes over the half symmetrical line then it will not be replicated on the other side. Close shapes are the only creation that can be made using this tool. **Double Clicking on a pattern outline** | This will end the shape / creation process. As long as you finish on a pattern outline or another seamless block line **Holding down Ctrl** | While creating a line if you hold down Ctrl curve points will be created **Holding down Shift** | While creating a seamless line if you hold down Shift this will give you 45 Degree angles for guidance **Selecting Backspace/ Delete** | While creating the lines if you select the back space this will delete the last created point ![Edit Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549969583001) **Edit Pattern** | **Selecting Seamless Blocked Line/ Point** **(**_**Single Left Click)**_ | Once the lines are created you can use the Edit pattern curve to edit the line or point. Click and dragging will move the line or point While dragging if you simultaneously right click a precision box will come up and you can edit the line using exact measurements Selecting the line using the edit pattern tool you can also delete the line or point as well. **Right Click on Pattern Outline or Seamless Line** | You can create more seamless blocked lines with the offset as seamless block line. From there you will be able to choose how many offset you would want to create, along with the distance that they should all be. Since closed shapes must always be created, the extend option will always be selected. **Editing Pattern line or Point** | when adjusting the pattern outline or point the seamless blocked lines will follow along with the pattern outline adjustments ![Transform Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563497113) **Transform Pattern** | **Dragging Point or Line** | The seamless block lines will follow the adjustments that are made to the whole pattern. It will follow based on proportion. ![Trace.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48549913094681) **Trace** | **Right Click on a Internal or Base line.** | There will be an option to convert to seamless block line. If the line/shape does not create a closed shape then CLO will not convert the internal line or base line into a seamless line. #### **Set Fabric** Fabric can be added to different seamless blocked sections through dragging and dropping the fabric from the object browser onto the seamless block area in either the 3D or 2D window. **📝Note:** _The assigning option within the object browser will not work when seamless blocking is applied_ Symmetry will not be followed when applying fabric with seamless blocking to allow for more creative options. ![seamless block fabric.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563495833) Using ![Transform Pattern On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48634465212313)**Transform Pattern** tool , you will be able to select the seamless block section by double clicking. From there you will be able to see the fabric within use, within your property editor under the fabric section ![Screenshot 2025-07-03 231547.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48555563498777) Properties that will apply to the entire pattern: * Information * Bond/Skive * Geometry * Arrangement * * * #### **📝Note:** * [**Graphic**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000483967-Apply-Graphic-Image) The seamless blocking lines will not interfere with any placement of the graphics, it will be applied as if there aren't any lines. * [**Topstitch**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002224507--Tool-Segment-Topstitch)** & **[**Puckering**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002227447--Tool-Segment-Puckering) These can be applied to seamless blocked lines as if they are internal lines using the Topstitch or Puckering tools to apply and edit onto the lines. * [**Print Layout**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000565568-Nest-Patterns) If seamless blocking is applied to the patterns it will be excluded from the print layout window. * **Compatibility with Older Versions** If opening up a seamless block file within a CLO version below 2025.1 the seamless blocked lines will reflect as baselines.
content_description: Discover the new seamless blocking feature in CLO 2025.1, allowing you to creatively section patterns for diverse fabrics and textures without cutting.

title: Garment Animation Making
content: **Objective** Tips for creating stable and realistic garment animation for multi-layered garments. ** Operation** **Optimize 3D Garment for Animation** The heavier the garment, the slower and harder it records. Follow the steps below to make it lighter. 1. For a multi-layered garment, increase particle distance to 20mm for inner layers that are not as visible as outer layers. 2. Delete invisible and any other unnecessary layers. 3. Outer layers: →Set the particle distance to 10mm for parts that does not require higher level of expression of wrinkles. →Set the particle distance to 5mm for parts that require higher level of expression of wrinkles. If there is large quantity of layers set to 5mm, set all of them to 7mm. ****Fix Garment**** If garment is not fixed to avatar while recording the animation, the garment moves drastically around the avatar due to collision. Certain parts of the garment need to be fixed to the avatar or itself to create more realistic recording. →Use functions such as 'Avatar Tape' or 'Tack on Avatar' to attach shoulder and sides of the garment. →Use 'Tack' function for overlapped layers or any parts that may dangle. **Increase Transition Animation Time** Increase the transition animation time for heavier garments. In the animation dialogue, enter 5FPS to stabilize the simulation. This makes the avatar movement slower which helps to minimize the collision between the garments. **Set Simulation Quality status on 'Complete' for the First Recording** Setting Simulation Quality status on 'Complete' minimizes the collision between the avatar and garments. To save time, the simulation quality can be set to 'Normal' for the middle part of the recording as the avatar and garments tend to collide more in the beginning and end. Make sure the simulation to set the quality back on 'Complete' for the end of the Transition Animation. **Reevaluate Draping of the Garment after the Recording** As the avatar moves, some parts of the garment may collide. When the simulation is off, the 3D garment may appear fine, however there is possibility of unnoticeable collision which may destabilize rest of the recording. →Return to Simulation Mode. **※ Note:** From ver2.5.0, it is possible to simulate by pressing the **Simulation** button without recording it. →Active simulation and make sure the entire garment simulation is stable. →If any parts of the garment is unstable, readjust the layers by using the **Select/Move** tool. →Once the simulation has been stabilized, go back to the Animation Mode. **Set Simulation Quality status on 'Complete' when Recording the Actual Garment Animation ** Make sure to set Simulation Quality status on 'Complete' for final recordings of Garment Animation as the 'Complete' and the 'Normal' give clearly different results in expressing reality.
content_description: This webpage provides essential tips for optimizing and stabilizing multi-layered garment animations to achieve realistic and high-quality simulations in 3D modeling.
